Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG UI energy-slash accent, wide landscape around 1536x1024 pixels, behind buttons and chapter headings in a personal portfolio.
Primary request: one original dynamic sweeping pale-yellow lightning brush slash, horizontal motion mostly across the center with a few vermilion and cobalt accents and tiny ink splatters. Refined American comic graffiti and ability VFX aesthetic, premium editorial art.
Scene/backdrop: truly transparent background with alpha everywhere outside the painted mark.
Style/medium: crisp ink and cel-animation shapes, imperfect drybrush screenprint edges, energetic and confident handprinted quality.
Color palette: main electric pale yellow #f2ef77, small vermilion #ef6448 and cobalt #6c89dd accents, subtle deep ink purple #211c38 outline if needed.
Composition/framing: single wide slash, centered, full design visible and uncropped, generous transparent margins above and below.
Constraints: no readable text, no logos, no franchise imagery, no photos, no 3D, no glow, no black background, no background rectangle, no checkerboard drawn into image. Output a genuinely transparent PNG.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square raster paper print texture, around 1024x1024 pixels, for a very low-opacity multiply layer across premium comic editorial UI surfaces.
Primary request: a completely flat warm-white/off-white paper print texture with extremely subtle monochrome fibers, dispersed fine ink speckle, and tiny irregular halftone dots. Very low contrast, visually quiet, evenly distributed paper texture.
Style/medium: uncoated printed paper grain, dry screenprint material, refined restrained texture.
Composition/framing: edge-to-edge square texture only, consistent uniform distribution, seamlessly tileable in both axes, no focal area.
Color palette: warm off-white base with barely visible pale gray monochrome fibers and sparse tiny gray ink specks.
Constraints: no objects, no gradients, no vignette, no letters, no readable text, no logos, no photographs of paper on a surface, no shadows, no folds, no strong creases, no distinct stains, no borders, no 3D. Entire image must be flat texture.
